description: ADR 0033 §5 (PROTOCOL 8.2): the hybrid sealed outer layer, zs2. (ct, K) = ML-KEM-768.Encaps(recipient sealEk, m); key = HKDF-SHA256(X25519(eph, recipientXPub) || K, empty, "z-sealed-v2" || ephPub || recipientXPub || SHA-256(ct), 32); envelope = "zs2." || b64url(ephPub || ct || nonce || box || mac), box = ChaCha20-Poly1305(key, nonce, aad "z-sealed-v2", §8's padded {f,p}). The KEM ciphertext sits outside the padding, so every bucket is the bucket a message lands in as zs1. and every zs2. envelope is 1 450 characters longer than its zs1. one. Draws are eph_seed, m and nonce, in that order. The three largest buckets are given by length and SHA-256 of the envelope, their payload payload_len copies of payload_fill. No client seals zs2. before 44.7, which waits for constant-time ML-KEM upstream.

must_refuse.name: kem_ct_swapped
must_refuse.why: bucket_1024 with its KEM ciphertext replaced by another encapsulation to the same sealing key (m below): K, and so the key, is another, and the AEAD fails

must_refuse.name: kem_ct_stripped_as_zs1
must_refuse.why: bucket_1024 with its KEM ciphertext removed and the prefix made zs1.: the zs1. key (below) has no K and another context, and the AEAD fails

must_refuse.name: kem_ct_stripped_as_zs2
must_refuse.why: the same, under zs2.: 1 084 bytes, shorter than the 1 148 of a zs2. body with an empty box

must_refuse.name: zs1_body_under_zs2
must_refuse.why: a genuine zs1. envelope to Bob from the 4 096 bucket (zs1_envelope, sealed with zs1_eph_seed and zs1_nonce), relabelled zs2.: its nonce and the start of its box are read as a KEM ciphertext, which decapsulates by implicit rejection to K, and the AEAD fails

must_refuse.name: zs2_body_under_zs1
must_refuse.why: bucket_1024 relabelled zs1.: the KEM ciphertext is read as the nonce and the box, and the AEAD fails

classical_adversary.name: x25519_key_without_sealing_seed
classical_adversary.why: bucket_1024 opened with Bob's X25519 seed — every classical private key — and another device's sealing seed (Carol's): its decapsulation is the implicit-rejection K below; with it, or with K = 0^32 (zero_K_key), the key is not the envelope's and the AEAD fails
